payload.reason: The evidence provides a comparison of a single-system performance against system combination results, highlighting improvements in word error rates (WER).

claims.text: The single-system achieved a WER of 41.6% on DEV and 43.2% on EVAL, which is a significant improvement over previous single-system results without system combination.
The single-system's WER of 41.6% and 43.2% compares favorably to the best previous single-system results of 45.1% and 47.3% without system combination.
The single-system uses 308 hours of training data, while the best previous results used 4500 hours, indicating efficiency in performance.
